purpose: find vulnerabilities in first-party source code by analysis before it runs, and drive findings to a fix or a recorded exception
entry_criteria: Code builds from a clean checkout at a pinned commit
Scanner and ruleset versions are chosen and recorded
A baseline of previously triaged findings exists, or an empty baseline is stated
procedure: Run the configured scanner on the exact commit; save the raw report (SARIF) and tool version.
Triage each new finding as true positive, false positive or accepted risk; a false positive needs a written reason and a suppression with owner and expiry.
For true positives rate severity by reachability and data exposure, not by rule severity alone.
Fix or open a tracked issue with SLA for every true positive; block the merge on critical and high findings.
Rerun the scanner on the fix commit and confirm the finding is gone and no new ones appeared.
Publish the report and the updated baseline with the commit id.
acceptance_criteria: Scan ran on the commit under review and covers all in-scope languages
No open critical or high true positive, or each has an approved exception
Every suppression has a reason, owner and expiry
Rerun after fixes shows zero regression
validation_method: Compare the rerun report against the pre-fix report for the same ruleset version.

validation.command: semgrep scan --config auto --sarif -o reports/sast.sarif --error   # example; use the project's configured scanner
validation.expect: exit 0 and no critical/high findings outside the approved baseline
number of results matches the triage log

failure_modes.mode: Scanner skipped part of the code
failure_modes.detection: Report file count is below the repository's source file count
failure_modes.response: Mark INCONCLUSIVE; fix includes/excludes and rerun

failure_modes.detection: Suppression register has entries without reason or expiry
failure_modes.response: Reject the suppression; reopen the finding

failure_modes.mode: Findings reported on a different commit
failure_modes.detection: Report commit id differs from the merge commit
failure_modes.response: Discard report; rerun on the correct commit

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The scanner flags string-built SQL in an export job. Triage: true positive, reachable by an authenticated user via a filter parameter, high severity. Fix replaces concatenation with a parameterized query and adds a regression test. Rerun shows the finding closed.
